name: @cleocode/cant
description: CANT DSL — cant-core (SSoT) parser, validator, and pipeline executor via napi-rs; agent identity, message parsing, and migration utilities

scripts.build:napi: pnpm --package=@napi-rs/cli@3.10.5 dlx napi build --platform --release --manifest-path ../../crates/cant-napi/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir napi --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts
scripts.build:napi:wasi: pnpm --package=@napi-rs/cli@3.10.5 --package=emnapi@1.11.3 dlx napi build --platform --release --manifest-path ../../crates/cant-napi/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir napi --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts --target wasm32-wasip1-threads
